01 — OUR STORY✳

Many flavours.
One happy table.

Rooted in Delhi.
Curious about everywhere.

Kitchen District brings the city's appetite for good food to a menu that travels. Indian favourites sit alongside global classics, with room for a new discovery or two.

Find us at Hyatt Centric Janakpuri. Come for a quiet breakfast, a long lunch, or dinner that turns into an evening.
